name: Stranger Danger
source:
It is late at night, and you need to take the bus home. The people on the bus seem nice enough, though are more talkative than usual...

[From [url=https://doodletaco.itch.io/stranger-danger]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
夜已經深了，你得坐公車回家。車上的人看起來都挺和善，只是比平常遇到的乘客健談了些……

［摘自[url=https://doodletaco.itch.io/stranger-danger]itch.io[/url]］
